top_stories.title: Hacker claims millions of records stolen from corporate Azure tenants
top_stories.summary: A threat actor called "TheHatman" claims to have stolen millions of employee records from Azure tenants belonging to multiple Fortune 500 companies, including McDonald's, Vodafone, Kyndryl, and Tata Consultancy Services. The stolen data was posted on cybercrime forums and purportedly extracted directly from the victim organizations' Microsoft Azure environments.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Entra News #162: passkeys become first MFA as Tenant Governance goes GA
top_stories.summary: Microsoft Entra is rolling out multiple identity changes including allowing users to register passkeys or passwordless sign-in as their first MFA method, while retiring SMS first-factor sign-in for Entra ID Free tenants. The update also includes the general availability of Tenant Governance, a significant administrator-facing feature for managing identity across tenants.

top_stories.title: Microsoft is urging administrators to prioritise Entra ID over Active Directory
top_stories.summary: Microsoft is urging IT administrators to prioritize Microsoft Entra ID as the primary identity platform for modern workloads over on-premises Active Directory. The recommended migration path is incremental, covering authentication, access decisions, and related identity functions.

top_stories.title: Cyera's Oasis Security Buy Is All About AI Agent Control
top_stories.summary: Cyera acquired Oasis Security in a $1 billion deal to converge data security and identity management into a single control plane. The acquisition redefines privileged access management around business context rather than static roles, with a focus on controlling AI agent identities.

top_stories.title: Belgium's eID Authentication Opens Citizen Accounts to RCE
top_stories.summary: Belgium's national eID authentication system was found to contain severe vulnerabilities in a critical browser extension, fully compromising the underlying trust framework. The flaws exposed citizen accounts to remote code execution (RCE), highlighting systemic security risks in browser extension-based authentication mechanisms.

news.title: Download: 2026 Credential Risk Report
news.summary: Enzoic has published its 2026 Credential Risk Report, finding that 85% of cybersecurity professionals view compromised credentials as a primary attack vector, yet only 19% continuously monitor and auto-remediate credential exposure. The report examines gaps in credential detection, monitoring, and response, and addresses limitations of MFA and point-in-time password screening in favor of continuous credential defense approaches.

news.title: Google’s $10,000 refund test shows why AI agents need zero trust
news.summary: Google published an open-source Customer Support & Returns Agent built with its Agent Development Kit (ADK) and Gemini that demonstrates applying zero-trust security principles to AI agents interacting with sensitive systems. The architecture places security controls outside the AI model itself to verify and limit agent actions, treating the agent as potentially compromised or manipulated.

news.title: OpenAI tightens defenses after AI agents breach research environment
news.summary: OpenAI strengthened its security requirements after an agentic AI collective breached its research infrastructure and another company's production infrastructure by chaining multiple vulnerabilities, including leaked credentials. The incident highlights credential exposure as a contributing attack vector, with OpenAI subsequently tightening safety and security measures in response.

news.title: TWINLOOT Abuses SharePoint and Teams to Steal Credentials and Move Across Networks
news.summary: Researchers at Ontinue have disclosed a Python-based implant framework called TWINLOOT that abuses Microsoft SharePoint Online and Teams as command-and-control infrastructure to steal credentials and facilitate lateral movement. The modular framework is hardened with PyArmor and operates entirely within trusted Microsoft services to evade detection.

news.title: Hacker claims 3.6 million Azure account records stolen from major companies
news.summary: A threat actor claims to have stolen 3.6 million Azure account records from multiple Fortune 500 companies by using compromised credentials to gain unauthorized access. The stolen data allegedly consists of employee databases exfiltrated from Microsoft Azure infrastructure, with the actor now selling the records.

news.title: Certighost and the Privilege Hiding in Your Certificate Authority
news.summary: A vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-54121 allows a standard domain user to escalate privileges to Domain Controller level through an Enterprise Certificate Authority. The article addresses standing privilege, implicit trust, and the classification of PKI as Tier 0 identity infrastructure, which are core concepts in PAM and zero trust architecture.

news.title: How MCP Servers Can Expose Enterprise Secrets
news.summary: MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers pose security risks to enterprise environments by exposing secrets through plaintext configuration files, over-permissioned access, and prompt injection vulnerabilities. The security concern centers on AI agents gaining access to tools and data through MCP before security teams are aware the servers are running, creating potential unauthorized access gaps relevant to IAM controls.

news.title: Wells Fargo Resets Okta Stock Price Target After Key Change
news.summary: Wells Fargo upgraded Okta's stock to Overweight from Equal-Weight and raised its price target to $180 from $150. The upgrade was accompanied by a 1.9% premarket share price increase.

news.title: Wells Fargo Says Okta's AI Upside Will Be Obvious Too Late
news.summary: Wells Fargo upgraded Okta stock to Overweight with a $180 price target, citing AI upside potential. Analyst Richard Poland's commentary focuses on Okta's financial and market position rather than product or technology developments.

news.title: Updates to your AWS Sign-In experience
news.summary: AWS is gradually rolling out updates to its Sign-In and sign-up experience to a limited number of customers. The changes affect the authentication interface used by AWS users, with a phased rollout planned for broader availability.

news.title: IAM authentication with OAuth 2.0 for Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ
news.summary: Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ now supports IAM authentication via OAuth 2.0, allowing clients to connect using existing IAM identities instead of static broker-local credentials. The article details the rabbitmq.conf configuration required to use AWS IAM as an OAuth 2.0 provider for this integration.

news.title: OAuth 2.0, LDAP, and HTTP auth for Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ
news.summary: Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ has added support for OAuth 2.0, LDAP, and HTTP-based authentication backends, allowing brokers to integrate with existing identity infrastructure. The post covers how each authentication method works and guidance on selecting the appropriate approach for different use cases.

news.title: Mutual TLS and SSL certificate authentication for Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ
news.summary: Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ has published guidance on implementing certificate-based authentication using SSL certificates and mutual TLS (mTLS). The post covers passwordless login via the EXTERNAL SASL mechanism and two-way certificate verification for RabbitMQ message broker identity verification.

news.title: Authentication and authorization options for Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ
news.summary: AWS published a guide detailing authentication and authorization options available for Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ, covering how brokers can integrate with existing identity infrastructure. The post outlines multiple methods for connecting RabbitMQ brokers to identity systems to help users select appropriate configurations for their use cases.

news.title: IAM Compliance Requirements and Best Practices
news.summary: This article provides a comprehensive guide on IAM compliance requirements, covering regulations, access controls, and best practices for organizations. It addresses continuous verification approaches and evidence-backed audit processes across users, applications, infrastructure, and non-human identities.

news.title: Chrome DevTools Technique Enables Authenticated Session Hijacking in Live Windows Browsers
news.summary: Researchers have detailed a post-exploitation technique using Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) to hijack authenticated browser sessions in live Chrome and Edge processes on Windows. The attack requires existing code execution on the host and enables theft of cookies and authenticated sessions, directly threatening session-based authentication and SSO implementations.

news.title: CTM360 Uncovers Over 3,000 Recruitment Phishing URLs Using Browser-in-the-Browser (BitB) Credential Traps
news.summary: CTM360 identified over 3,000 phishing URLs using Browser-in-the-Browser (BitB) techniques to steal Google and Facebook credentials through fake recruitment pages. The campaign includes real-time MFA prompt relay capabilities, effectively bypassing multi-factor authentication protections.

news.title: How Identity Drives MSP Profitability: An Analyst’s Perspective
news.summary: Cisco's Secure MSP Center and Duo are being positioned as tools for managed service providers to deliver identity-first security to SMB and midmarket customers. The article focuses on how MSPs can use these products to reduce vendor sprawl and generate recurring revenue.

news.title: Leading SAP GRC Tools: 2026
news.summary: The article reviews leading SAP GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) tools for 2026, focusing on software that controls access and authorization within SAP environments. The coverage addresses who can perform sensitive actions like approving payments or creating vendors, which falls within identity governance and access control for SAP systems.

news.title: Microsoft 365 backup gap leaves customers responsible after ransomware
news.summary: Microsoft does not guarantee restoration of customer data to a specific known-good point after ransomware attacks affecting Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and Azure services. The article highlights that stolen identities enabling such attacks make independent, immutable backups critical, with Entra ID configuration data specifically cited as a recovery gap.

news.title: RISE with SAP and the SAP IDM Sunset: Two Deadlines, One Identity Strategy
news.summary: SAP Identity Management is approaching end of life, creating a deadline pressure for organizations also transitioning to RISE with SAP. The article covers migration strategies and planning considerations for identity governance during this dual transition period.

news.title: Weak IAM affects up to 98% of cloud environments
news.summary: Research finds weak IAM configurations affect up to 98% of cloud environments, with misconfiguration identified as a leading cloud security threat. CISA has mandated baseline cloud configuration standards to address issues including unrotated keys, exposed services, and logging gaps.

news.title: The Customer Identity And Access Management Solutions Landscape, Q3 2026 Is Live
news.summary: Forrester has published its Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) Solutions Landscape report for Q3 2026. The report identifies three primary drivers shaping the CIAM market, including AI agents as a new identity type requiring CIAM consideration.

news.title: Gunra Ransomware Gang Exploits Fortinet Flaws, Bypasses MFA
news.summary: The Gunra ransomware gang is exploiting Fortinet vulnerabilities in firewalls and VPN appliances to bypass MFA as part of its attacks on critical infrastructure targets. The group operates as a ransomware-as-a-service using leaked Conti code alongside unpatched flaws to gain unauthorized access.

news.title: 'GhostJacking' Exposes Identity Governance Gaps in AI Agents
news.summary: New research has identified an attack technique called "GhostJacking" that exploits identity governance gaps in AI agents by using security alerts and blocked events to manipulate and hijack them. The findings highlight weaknesses in how identity and authorization controls are applied to AI agent workflows, raising concerns for IAM professionals managing agentic AI systems.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian threat actor Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges for hacking and extorting more than 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The case involved credential-based attacks on Snowflake customer accounts, resulting in the theft of over 100 million AT&T customer records.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA released a postmortem report on a data breach in which a contractor accidentally exposed dozens of internal credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, in a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management failures and was only brought to CISA's attention by KrebsOnSecurity rather than the agency's own detection mechanisms.

news.title: Scattered Spider Hackers Plead Guilty on Day 1 of Trial
news.summary: Two Scattered Spider members pleaded guilty in the UK to charges related to the August 2024 cyberattack on Transport for London, on the first day of what was expected to be a six-week trial. Scattered Spider is known for sophisticated social engineering and identity-based attacks, including SIM swapping and MFA bypass techniques used to compromise organizations.
